Description: Mediocre and subpar would probably be compliments to this ‘’game’’.

Headline: Duty Calls it’s fans

Headline: New Realistic Tactic Shooter - Rainbow 7 Rush
Description: ‘’A deeply tactical game that forces players to play in a team or fail in the pursuit of individual glory.’’ - One of our testers, describing the game.

Headline: Even Ex-Super Soldiers approve this Game
Description: Rainbow 7 Rush is apparently so tactically viable that even Ex-Special Forces are saying that it's good. Ain’t that an endorsement?

Headline: Future 3 Release!
Description: This time players can explore gas giants as well. However that is not the only new feature - Grappling hooks are now also part of the game!

Headline: Asphyxiate your foes!
Description: … gas giants of our solar system. And from what we could spy from the trailers, the player is able to use that to their sinister advantage …

Headline: Near Cry 7 - New Biom For The Series
Description: This time we can explore the Desert. Some fans have already spotted some camels in the promotional Material and excitement has been rampant.

Headline: Machine Gun Camels in Near Cry 7
Description: This is a sentence I never thought I would write. The madmen of the Near Cry developer team have done the impossible - making camels cool.

Headline: NOT even the Camels can SAFE Near Cry 7 now!
Description: We loved our cuddly friends before the gameplay trailer. But now we know that they can’t walk properly without clipping into the ground!

Headline: Near Cry 7 Shows INSANE New Features
Description: After the hour-long gameplay session, our team has compiled a list of all the new exciting features this game offers over its predecessors!

Headline: Near Cry 7 RELEASE - Will it flop?
Description: Following the disastrous release of the gameplay, fans were eager to see if the devs had addressed and fixed their concerns…

Headline: Near Cry 7 - It’s Gooood!
Description: We always believed in the game. When everyone was blaming the poor gameplay trailer only we could see the true potential of the game!
